The proposal's representation set (raw tanh)

Source: R/representations.R
riposte_reps_proposal.Rd

riposte_reps_default() with Huber's psi replaced by the raw tanh(y) that the "Power for Policy" proposal used (as do manytestsr's pIndepDist() and pCombCauchyDist()), for reproducing the proposal's tables exactly. Prefer riposte_reps_default() for real outcomes, whose scale tanh(y) does not respect.

Usage

riposte_reps_proposal()

Value

a named list of representation functions.
